reference_code.contents: Reference log contains common/DMC/PD fault counters and compact failure records, not a full CC-wire transcript. Debug code filters attach/trace categories from flash and stores one extra data byte for retained events; UART logging is a separate build feature.
reference_code.bos: Reference internal Billboard copies alternate-mode status and current software-held EUDO into BOS. These are device-reported state, not a recording of the Enter_USB exchange.
reference_code.applicability: No proof DEG2 uses this implementation, build feature, getter or request table. Matching endpoints and configurable VID/PID are only reasons to compare the implementation.
